integrity: Exhaustive exact finite computations have two separately implemented standard-library programs in this package. All mathematical implications, group actions and coefficients are specified, with no claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: The conclusion is the rational GL(3,2)-representation on reduced degree-three homology for the Fano-plane Heawood independence complex. It does not determine the integral representation lattice, a full automorphism-group extension by dualities, an equivariant homotopy classification or a generalization to higher-order projective planes. Equivalent unindexed computations remain a bibliographic possibility.
title: The exceptional rational homology representation of the Heawood independence complex
